t: This is Maryland station, a stop on the Great Eastern Main Line in the London Borough of Newham. It sits between Stratford and Forest Gate, about seven kilometres out from Liverpool Street, in fare zone three. The station was designed by Thomas Bennett, an English architect who was knighted and is best remembered for his part in developing the new towns of Crawley and Stevenage. So a small suburban station here shares a designer with some of the best-known planned towns in the south of England.
